tagline.zh: 华夏古瓷三维研学空间
tagline.en: A 3D Study Space for Ancient Chinese Ceramics

title.zh: 天青泥火 · 华夏古瓷三维研学空间
title.en: Tianqing Nihuo · A 3D Study Space for Ancient Chinese Ceramics

description.zh: 天青泥火：从泥到火，从器到鉴。用三维建模复原、工序互动与釉料实验，讲宋代名窑瓷器的一生。
description.en: Tianqing Nihuo: from clay to fire, from vessel to connoisseurship. 3D reconstructions, hands-on process labs and glaze experiments that tell the life of a Song-dynasty ceramic.

storyline.zh: 从泥到火，从器到鉴——数字化复原宋瓷的一生
storyline.en: From clay to fire, from vessel to connoisseurship — the life of a Song ceramic, digitally reconstructed

title.zh: 器以载道 · 格物致知

lead.zh: 雨过天青云破处，这般颜色做将来。这里用三维建模复原十件宋元明清名窑器型，带你看清一件瓷器，亲手造一件瓷器，再回到它所在的时代。
lead.en: Ten ceramic forms from the Song to Qing dynasties, reconstructed in 3D: look closely at a vessel, shape one yourself, then step back into its time.

featuredCaption.zh: 南宋官窑·八方贯耳弦纹瓶（Blender 建模复原，实时渲染）
featuredCaption.en: Southern Song Guan ware octagonal vase (Blender reconstruction, real-time)

note.zh: 10 件建模复原 · 5 件 CC0 对照标本

honesty.zh: 本站器物为教学用途的三维建模复原与第三方 CC0 模型，不是文物的实测扫描；涉及数值的结论均标注为文献范围值或教学示意。
honesty.en: The vessels here are educational 3D reconstructions and third-party CC0 models, not measured scans of artefacts. Numerical claims are marked as literature ranges or teaching illustrations.
